★ Request
Dantsu Flame smiles with a relieved "Thank goodness~" look,
and firmly pumps herself up to keep doing her best at this pace (not a serious expression,
more of an upbeat "Let's do this!" vibe)

At this rate, she should be able to make her debut without any problems.
Dantsu Flame, too, must be fired up for the upcoming real deal.

Dantsu Flame rejoicing is a familiar sight. However,
what she's harboring deep inside right now... is likely something I don't know.

I'm so sorry! Actually, I was planning to check
with you about this today, Trainer...!
I haven't won, have I? In the selection races.

Huh? Yes.
Because, I...

Huh? ...Ah, for the mock race!
Right, my name gets listed just by putting in a request...!
I have to... push myself harder...!

...An Umamusume worthy of being a "protagonist" wouldn't lose in the selection races.
I haven't... proven yet that I can be a "protagonist."

I truly intend to go all out and beat Pokke-chan and the others!
So please, won't you consider it...!

Unlike me, they're overflowing with raw talent, clutch under pressure...!
They have this aura that makes everyone think they're on a completely different level...!

Phew, good work today~!
...Trainer. How did my run look today?

She is under contract with me right now. In other words,
the essential requirements for her debut are already in place.

That's why she desperately wanted to get stronger, piling on every bit of effort she could.
And yet, ――

Yes, I'm off!
――...I was really happy that you took the time to talk with me.

...For some reason,
Dantsu Flame's name was undeniably written there.

Um... I thought this would be my chance
to prove that I can truly be a "protagonist."

So, I have to prove
that I'm someone who can go toe-to-toe with Pokke-chan and the others!
Yes, what is it?
Um... Was it bad of me to submit the request beforehand after all...?

Um, about after this...
Could I do just a little bit more solo practice?

Only a short while had passed
since signing the contract with Dantsu Flame――

It might be sudden, but could I go do some solo training after this?
I want to do everything I can right now...!

!
Alright then, I'm heading out!

They told me registration would close if I didn't submit early, though,
so I rushed to submit it... I guess I got the order backwards, huh?

Even after signing the contract, she continues to work earnestly without change.
Her forward-looking attitude is reassuring.

Even the veterans have their eyes on it,
saying this matchup might foretell the future of the racing scene...!

Therefore, prioritizing adjustments for her debut race should come first,
and entering this mock race, frankly speaking, holds almost no practical value...

I wanted to reflect on today's session on my own.
So that next time, I can become the "protagonist"...!

...Dantsu Flame's eyes are utterly earnest.
There isn't a shred of doubt in her feelings or her words.

It's a precious chance to compete against both of them at the same time.
If I can race here... If I can win...!

Her expression is desperate. She is simply and purely trying her hardest to get stronger.
Her sheer determination is clearly palpable, even from afar――

――Hey, did you see the mock race schedule that was updated this morning?
Word is there's a really interesting race coming up.
――Everything was going smoothly. Or so I had thought.

The amount and intensity of the solo training she's doing far exceeds my imagination.
To think she's doing this on top of her regular routine...

I'm sure I can aim to be a "protagonist" too...!
I believe I can prove that I'm ready to debut!

...After that, curious about Dantsu Flame's solo training,
I secretly watched her from a distance. And I was astonished.

Looking at the list of requested entries my colleague handed me,
I was left speechless.

*Pant*... *pant*... *gasp*...――
Alright... Just one more set...!

While considering the timing for her debut race,
we were currently conducting sensible training focused on fundamentals.

Look, right here. Agnes Tachyon and Jungle Pocket!
Two of the top prospects among those approaching their debuts are running.

I mean, Tachyon-chan and Pokke-chan are already such amazing Umamusume,
like they're destined "protagonists" even before debuting...!

Her voice, coming from right in front of me, sounds distant.
...Or perhaps she was never close to begin with――

...I must learn it anew.
The true feelings harbored within the Umamusume I'm supposed to support――

...Ever since the selection race until today, she had been regretting it all along.
She even believed, "There's no way I should be debuting like this."

...An intense sense of dissonance. Along with it, a creeping anxiety.
A sense of urgency mounts within me to uncover the truth behind this feeling.

That's... true, isn't it?
I'm sorry for bringing this up so suddenly.
...That night.

Hmm... Looking at it like this, my center of gravity really is off...
...Ah, Trainer! Good work today.
